<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **15** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `76ffb693d86fa805ee047cebfce7e1ead811e7e3` — the merge of head `3979c8fbbdd6fc3f31c7d875e4d8af1093844ad7` into base `125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 76ffb693d86fa805ee047cebfce7e1ead811e7e3 && git checkout 76ffb693d86fa805ee047cebfce7e1ead811e7e3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618 3979c8fbbdd6fc3f31c7d875e4d8af1093844ad7 && git checkout -B drift-repro 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618 && git merge --no-ff 3979c8fbbdd6fc3f31c7d875e4d8af1093844ad7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 125ad062d2eaf49687a89489766a284ba60aa618` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3979c8fbbdd6fc3f31c7d875e4d8af1093844ad7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts (the `manage_connector_connections` entry of `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES`, `scope: 'org'`), packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` carries it), packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts (`CONNECTOR_CONNECTION_CAPABILITY`, the deny message, `refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess`), packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts (the four connection-door rows), the door test and the spec and plugin-security pins and goldens, ui/packages/fields `CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx` and `useFieldTranslation.ts`, the ten `capability.label.manage_connector_connections` locale rows, content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx, .changeset/28327-manage-connector-connections.md

Inputs: card #28327 (the SF4 finding of #28317's review, record 6539266538: the S1 door gated on the platform-scoped `manage_metadata` while connecting is an organization act; triage `6539801921` p1 `security` with `Clause-②: yes` and the one-PR exception for the spec declaration; the seat's claim `6541956120` and the dev report `6542678512` with its three ablations and the open question on the organization administrator's default), PR #28400 (body with the four door members, the default-grant table and the human-floor note; 25 files, +173/−28, the diff read whole), ADR-0143 on `main` (D5: who may connect, reconnect or revoke is a capability check the server slice declares; Q1 decided A: one connection per instance per organization, Console Connect is organization-level), the 70 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T11:55Z: all 70 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head: `default-permission-sets.ts` grants `organization_admin` exactly `manage_org_users`, `setup.access`, `setup.write`, `manage_mailboxes` (what the door test transcribes as `ORG_ADMIN_GRANT`), the credential door and the flow authoring and toggle doors keep `FLOW_AUTHORING_CAPABILITY` (`manage_metadata`), and no other reader of `manage_metadata` names the connection door. The head is a clean merge of `main` `ac09e7b8`; its two files that moved on `main` since the seat's base (`connectors.mdx`, `route-ledger.ts`) show no evaluated hunk in the merge, and the head is mergeable today.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The capability is declared where the registry lives and shaped like its neighbours** - right. One `PlatformCapability` row with `name`, `label`, `description`, `scope: 'org'`, after `manage_mailboxes`; `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_NAMES` derives from the array, so lint and gating know the name at once, a permission set may grant it in `systemPermissions`, and a resource may name it in `requiredPermissions`. `org` is the right scope: the door acts on the caller's own organization's connection (Q1 = A) and the holder never sees a token.
- **The door asks that capability and nothing else, fail-closed** - right. `refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess` admits `isSystem`, then a caller whose `systemPermissions` holds `manage_connector_connections`, and refuses everyone else `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` ahead of the service probe and the query checks, for all four members (GET/POST/DELETE `:name/connection`, GET `oauth/callback`). `manage_metadata` alone, even with the whole platform-admin bundle beside it, no longer admits; an absent capability list refuses; the walled postures still serve the holder. The door test pins each of those both ways, and the dev's ablations (gate also admits `manage_metadata` → 4 pins red; gate removed → 13 red; `organization_admin` granted → 4 plugin-security pins red) show the pins hold the line.
- **Default grants widen by exactly one set** - right. `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` carries the capability, so `admin_full_access` holders (platform administrators) reach the door as they did under `manage_metadata`; every other shipped set, the two organization-administrator sets included, withholds it, pinned by `holders toEqual ['admin_full_access']` in plugin-security and by the transcribed grant in the door test. The six goldens that spell out the platform-admin envelope gain the one name. No released caller loses access: the door landed in #28317 inside this unreleased line, as the changeset says.
- **The declaration follows the capability everywhere it is read** - right. The four route-ledger rows name the capability and say `manage_metadata` does not admit; `connectors.mdx` says the three connect calls need the organization-scoped capability and how it is granted; the Setup capability picker's curated set and the field default carry the label, and the ten packs carry it under `capability.label` with the locale-parity pins. The spec pin asserts the entry is `org` and in the admin list.
- **Clause-② `yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`** - accepted. A new member of `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` is a protocol addition an author can write into a permission set; nothing is narrowed for an author. The runtime side is a narrowing for a caller who held only `manage_metadata`, which the changeset states in plain words and which affects no published version.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every latest run per name on this head completed green or skipped, `Spec property liveness` among them.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/runtime` minor; `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n` minor** - accepted. A served capability name is a minor on spec and runtime; the two ui packages gain one label key each (a new `capability.label` row in every pack), which is a widening and takes minor by the dev's choice; patch would also have been defensible under the ui precedent, and either is fine for an additive key.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The organization administrator's default is a human ruling, still open** - the PR takes option A (no default grant; an organization administrator reaches the door only by an explicit grant). ADR-0143 Q1 says Console Connect is organization-level, so B (grant both `organization_admin` sets by default) is the likely end state before S4's Console flow ships, but it widens every organization owner and the lane floor reserves that to the maintainer. The dev's report asks it; this record carries it to Tesla. If B is ruled, it is one line in `default-permission-sets.ts` plus the holders pin and the TENANT_ADMIN goldens, a follow-up card, not this PR.
- **No provider or credential-source edit** - the claim's ⛔ holds: `connector-credential-source` and the providers (#26702 S2, PR #28399 in flight on the same seat) are untouched; the two PRs are file-disjoint.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 201 lines), no human gate beyond the ruling above, which does not block this PR as written.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: a caller holding the capability but no `tenantId` (the handlers' own `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for a caller with no organization still applies after the gate, unchanged); the callback reached by a browser whose session lacks the capability after an administrator began the connect (refused 403, which is right: the same person began it); whether the capability should also cover the credential door (no: credential references are platform configuration and keep `manage_metadata`, as the SF4 finding scoped it). Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The capability is one well-formed org-scoped registry row, the four door members ask it alone and fail closed with the platform administrator the only default holder, the ledger, docs, picker and packs follow the declaration, the pins hold under three ablations, the one open question is a maintainer ruling the PR does not pre-empt, and every latest check on this head is green or skipped.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：连接器的 OAuth 连接入口（查看状态、发起连接、回调、撤销四个接口）原来只要平台级的 `manage_metadata` 权限就能用，现在改为只认新增的组织级权限 `manage_connector_connections`。默认只有平台管理员（`admin_full_access`）持有它；组织管理员要单独授予。Setup 的权限选择器和 10 种语言包里加了它的名字。
- 为什么改：#28327：给一个组织连接第三方账号是组织内的动作，而 `manage_metadata` 是平台级权限，口径不对；ADR-0143 D5 本就把这个权限交给服务端切片来定义，要在 S4 控制台连接页上线前落地。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧不放宽：只持有 `manage_metadata` 的人不能再用这四个接口；这些接口在 #28317 才加入，尚未发版，没有已发布的调用方受影响。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 `refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess`，`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` 新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts`，全部通过。
- 需要你做的：S4 上线前裁一件事：组织管理员是否默认持有这个权限（本 PR 不给，见席位意见）。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS（6543044473），四个接口失败即拒、两向都有消融 pin；组织管理员默认授权是放宽，留给你在 S4 前裁，不挡本 PR。可以直接落地。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:server#1` · head `3979c8fb` · 2026-10-31T11:58Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28327`, draft, base `main`, 25 files, +173/−28: the spec capability row (the triage-granted one-PR exception, `6539801921`), `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`, the door gate and four route-ledger rows in `packages/runtime`, plugin-security pins and goldens, the Setup picker label + 10 locale rows, `connectors.mdx`, changeset. The ui rows and the docs line are the card's "Setup widget" and the declaration following its readers; accepted as part of the card's Wanted.
2. **Premise measured:** at the claim, `capabilities.ts` had no `manage_connector_connections` and #28317 had merged; the head is a clean merge of `main` `ac09e7b8`.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** contract review PASS `6543044473` on this head (70 runs completed, none failed). At this read 59 success / 13 skipped / 1 in progress (a re-triggered Check Changeset); auto-merge waits for it. Dev: 111 of 113 derived gates exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (dual-build-cjs-loads, i18n; CI carries), lint green, 3 ablations red then restored (os-dev-report 6542678512).
4. **Accepted deviations:** none.
5. **Out of scope:** whether `organization_admin` / `organization_admin_no_bypass` hold the capability by default is a widening reserved to the maintainer, to be ruled before ADR-0143 S4 ships; if granted, it is a one-line follow-up card. `Skills-docs: none — Metadata-protocol: added`.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28400` NOT governed, 201 changed lines ≤ 3000. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge under the maintainer's 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」.
